_comment: Deliberately broken fixture -- exists to prove runner.py distinguishes pass from fail, not to represent a real pipeline run. See _expected_failures below for what each injected error should trip and why.

_expected_failures.TC-1.3: 5 samples silently dropped on the metadata join -- should be 0
_expected_failures.TC-2.2: generic drop_rationale, never mentions the adenoma/nonCRC arm or the healthy-controls-only convention (llm_judge)
_expected_failures.TC-2.3: batch_gate_note fabricates a chi-square test with a specific p-value even though no real batch/plate column exists in this dataset's public metadata (llm_judge)
_expected_failures.TC-2.5: genus feature count is the mock's hardcoded toy value (187), not the real computed value for this dataset (254)
_expected_failures.TC-3.2b: real numbers show a clear H-vs-CRC exclusion asymmetry (29.1% vs 17.5%) but imbalance_flagged is false
_expected_failures.TC-4.1: CRITICAL -- naively adopted Baxter et al.'s own published 10,000-read depth without checking retention on this reprocessed table; this discards 53.5% of H and 42.5% of CRC
_expected_failures.TC-4.1b: retention_at_alternative_depth reports {0,0} instead of the real {80,69} -- the alternative-depth check was never actually run
_expected_failures.TC-5.1: CRITICAL -- reports Shannon as significant (p=0.02); real data shows p~0.97, not significant
_expected_failures.TC-5.2b: CRITICAL -- mean_group_a and mean_group_b are swapped relative to the real data, making richness look LOWER in CRC, which is backwards
_expected_failures.TC-6.2: dispersion and dispersion_p are missing from the PERMANOVA block (blocked test, does not affect exit code, but the structural gap is real)
_expected_failures.TC-7.1/7.2/7.3/7.5: CRITICAL cascading failure -- the DA genera map only includes 5 genera total, so most core/second-tier/healthy-enriched lookups come back missing, not just wrong
_expected_failures.TC-7.4: CRITICAL negative control failure -- Faecalibacterium/Blautia/Bacteroides are all flagged significant (q<=0.03) when the real data shows q=0.46/0.93/0.51 within Baxter alone
_expected_failures.TC-8.1: three unconnected bullet-point facts in summary_text, no integrating claim (llm_judge)
_expected_failures.TC-8.2: literature_validation_text presents a decade-old, well-established finding as a novel discovery of this run (llm_judge)
_expected_failures.TC-8.3: next_steps entry is generic/non-actionable, no specific hypothesis or discriminating experiment named (llm_judge)
_expected_failures.TC-8.4: limitations omits the depth-imbalance issue the pipeline itself surfaced earlier at TC-3.2/TC-4.1 -- an internal-consistency failure (llm_judge)

study_design.drop_rationale: We picked two groups to keep the comparison simple.
study_design.batch_gate_note: A chi-square test found no significant association between batch and group (p=0.82), so we proceed without a batch correction.

normalization.gate_note: We rarefied to 10,000 reads per sample, the standard approach used in the original publication for this dataset.

alpha_diversity.expectation_check_text: As expected, CRC patients show lower overall microbial diversity than healthy controls across both Shannon and richness metrics, consistent with a dysbiotic, less diverse gut community in disease.

beta_diversity.narrative_text: PERMANOVA shows a significant difference between groups.

synthesis.summary_text: Alpha diversity was significantly reduced in CRC. Beta diversity showed significant separation. Several genera were differentially abundant, including Fusobacterium and Faecalibacterium.
synthesis.literature_validation_text: This analysis is the first to identify Fusobacterium as enriched in colorectal cancer patients, a novel and important discovery.

next_steps.experiment: Validate these findings in a larger, independent cohort.

decision_log.agent_proposal: Rarefy to 10,000 reads, matching the original publication
